title: ShareToshi
tagline: ShareToshi brings POCM to ETH.  Donate, Support and Crowdfund your projects and receive your stakes back.
description:
Sharetoshi is a tool for cost-free donations, supporting, and crowdfunding, built in a trust-less and low-risk environment. 

Everyone can create a campaign, and start getting support.
and everyone else can start supporting people, ideas, projects, hobbies, social goods, receiving the initial stakes always back.
how_its_made:
The first ingredient are the Enzyme Vaults, which we set to 99% performance fee (For manager)

Transforming the Vault in a yield donation tool.



We see the list of all the token holders who are eligible to receive it. The reward for the depositor of the vault are token stream via Superfluid to the vault token holders.
